note: XVII cast audit (Ian, 17 Nov): Seward and Arthur clean-shaven, no spectacles, Jonathan white-haired.

beats.text: Remove the moustache from the dark-haired man standing behind the desk, so that his chin, jaw and upper lip are bare and clean-shaven, painted in the same light.
Remove the moustache from the tall young man in black holding the papers, so that his chin, jaw and upper lip are bare and clean-shaven, painted in the same light.
Remove the spectacles from the man at the drawer; keep his face otherwise the same, clean-shaven, eyes visible, in the same light.

Make the young man's hair pure snow-white, like an old man's, though his face stays young and clean-shaven; he is Jonathan Harker, whose hair turned white from shock. Paint the white hair in the same light.
